properties.name: Santa Rosa business district destroyed in the earthquake and fire of 18 April 1906
properties.note: The earthquake and the fire that followed destroyed Santa Rosa's downtown ('the entire downtown'; about a hundred dead). No published outline: ESTIMATED as the business blocks between Third and Fifth streets, B Street to E Street (corners from today's street centrelines) - the brick blocks round the courthouse square on the 1904 Sanborn sheets. The frame houses beyond, which the 1904 and 1908 sheets both show, are taken to have survived.
